story_type: boat on fire, survivors paddle away in a small inflatable raft, helicopter airlift from the water
hook: Their boat was burning. All they had was a tiny raft.
narration: Their boat was on fire, and all they had left was a tiny inflatable raft.
Two men dug in with a paddle and rowed away from the flames.
Behind them, black smoke poured off the burning boat.
Another person in the water reached the raft and held on.
A Coast Guard helicopter came in low through the smoke.
A rescue swimmer rides the hoist cable down, gets each survivor into a harness or basket, and comes back up with them.
outcome: Coast Guard helicopter crews airlifted the survivors out of the water.
title: Boat on fire, escape in a tiny raft
description:
In September 2009, survivors of a boat fire near Corpus Christi, Texas, rowed away from the flames in a small raft before Coast Guard helicopter crews airlifted them from the water.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/68743/vessel-fire-rescue
